assertions.name: symbolic_f_bond_matches_numeric_at_q0
assertions.source: symbolic f_pp(q₀) == numeric z(q₀); the fibre expression realizes correctly at the archimedean anchor.

description: Pre-archimedean (fibre / formal-q) derivation of the per-bond trace factor f_bond(q) = c·z + d — the Markov conditional expectation of the inter-nucleon bridge crossing (a Hecke fact, NOT archimedean). f_pp=z=√q/(q+1), f_nn=z−h, f_pn=z−h(½−δ/4). tr_M is the Z_q Wedderburn heat trace (cf. peaceful-brown §3-bis); binding = E_0·log(tr_free/tr_atom) = E_0·Σ_bonds log(1/f_bond) is the q-heat free-energy difference (positive, no |·|). The only archimedean step is q→q₀ at the end.

data.peaceful_brown_link: tr_M = Σ_λ y_λ χ_λ is the Z_q heat trace; f_bond is the depth-1 bridge multiplier on the Wedderburn eigenbasis; binding is the q-heat free energy. See claude/peaceful-brown-hrt19q §3-bis + QBetaPreArchHeatDepthOneKernel.lean.
